name: find-skills
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：find-skills。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.
